items.title: Coherence of a pushforward under Nagata, universally catenary and a dimension condition on the associated points
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file local-cohomology.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The counted statement proves the coherence of the pushforward of a coherent module from an open subscheme of a locally Noetherian scheme, under the hypotheses that the scheme is Nagata and universally catenary and that the localisations of the closures of the associated points at the points of the complement have dimension at least two (author lemma at source lines 1775-1789, label lemma-finiteness-pushforward). The proof (source lines 1791-1833) reduces to the structure sheaf of an integral subscheme through an associated point using the criterion of this chapter, embeds its pushforward into the pushforward of a coherent module obtained from the normalization in the residue field, and verifies the depth condition required by the Hartogs type criterion: a failure of depth two would force a local ring of the normalization to have dimension one, contradicting the dimension formula and the hypothesis (proof lines 1816-1832). The embedding into the finite pushforward and the depth verification are the content. H3.
